TASK-101.title: Establish the two-checkout workflow and executable baseline gates
TASK-101.description:
Prepare Lap and RapidRAW-engine for scoped development. Reconcile P2/P6/P7 using the fresh Lap revision and writable-sidecar design. Existing RapidRAW checkout remains untouched. Governing contract: docs/raw-development/spec.md. Work locally on the dedicated feature branches; no publication or changes to the original RapidRAW checkout. Do not close this implementation issue unless its acceptance criteria pass.

Acceptance criteria:
- Both repository revisions, local feature branches and spec digest are recorded in a reproducible development manifest.
- Lap test runner and regression-test command exist alongside npm --prefix src-vite run build; the Rust tests use rustup/MSVC consistently.
- Required native submodules are initialized; missing toolchain/build dependencies are repaired locally or block this task with exact diagnostics.
- Create a linked extraction issue through pb in RapidRAW-engine before source edits. Baseline failures have command logs; required focused development gates pass.

Verification:
- Check git rev-parse HEAD in both checkouts and SHA256 of the copied spec.
- Run npm --prefix src-vite run build, the new frontend test command, cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml, cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check, and cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets in Lap.
- Run all canonical RapidRAW AGENTS.md gates in RapidRAW-engine, distinguishing inherited lint/format failures from regressions.
- Record exact commands, results, fixture/engine revisions and RED/GREEN evidence through pb; run git diff --check.

Constraints:
- Prepend rustup bin to PATH for every cargo command; Windows uses default features, never --all-features.
- Keep originals immutable, explicit errors visible, and unknown qualification results unclaimed.

Implementation notes:
- Prerequisite task outputs are mandatory dependency gates, not assumed existing capabilities.
- Keep the shared schema and engine authoritative across both hosts; obey each checkout AGENTS.md.

Implementation steps:
- Read both repository instructions and manifest/build scripts; record source commits and tool versions.
- Initialize native submodules using their pinned gitlinks and establish a small Vue unit/component test runner without inventing an existing npm test script.
- Create a linked RapidRAW Pebbles issue, preserve known failures and repair stale generated paths only in the isolated checkout.
- Document common gate commands, local dependency locations and the writable-sidecar assumption; prove the focused tests run.

Intermediate checks:
- Run the smallest behavior regression before implementation and capture the expected failure.
- Run the same regression after implementation, then the issue-specific integration checks; inspect the diff for scope and unintended source writes.

Expected areas:
- docs/raw-development/development-manifest.json
- docs/raw-development/baseline.md
- src-vite/package.json
- src-vite/tests/**
- scripts/**
- ../RapidRAW-engine/AGENTS.md

Parallel scope paths:
- docs/raw-development/development-manifest.json
- docs/raw-development/baseline.md
- src-vite/package.json
- src-vite/tests/**
- scripts/**
- ../RapidRAW-engine/AGENTS.md

Exclusive resources:
- raw-development-cross-repository

Source references:
- docs/raw-development/spec.md
- P2
- P6
- P7
